name: Queensland Free Apprenticeships for Under 25s
summary: Free training for Queensland apprentices and trainees under 25 in high priority qualifications.
key: Covers the cost of your training in a high priority apprenticeship or traineeship.
who: Employed as a Queensland apprentice or trainee in a high priority qualification
Training with a Skills Assure Supplier
catches: Must start between 1 January 2021 and 30 June 2027; funding continues to completion.
Uniforms, resources and travel may still cost extra.

source.label: Queensland Government: Free Apprenticeships for Under 25s

evidence.quote: covers the cost of your training when you choose a high priority apprenticeship or traineeship.
